maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The three keypoints in the top row are distributed linearly with a horizontal inter-point distance approximately 1.5 times the diameter of a single spot. The row sits superior to the primary dense row, with the anterior-most keypoint positioned vertically above the second spot of the row immediately below it.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium exhibits approximately 92% melanin saturation, with high-contrast dark pixels covering the majority of the apex, and a localized cluster of pink/pale pixels on the lateral-right margin.
